sentiment.rationale: The company reported a modest beat on adjusted EPS ($4.33 vs $4.17 prior year, +5.6%) and raised full-year sales guidance to $84.5-$85.5 billion (from $83.5-$84.5 billion) primarily due to the inclusion of ADG, not organic improvement. Core business guidance for comparable sales (flat to +1%) and adjusted operating margin (12.2%-12.3%) was reaffirmed unchanged. Management expressed confidence in long-term drivers but acknowledged near-term headwinds (elevated mortgage rates, cautious consumer). The guidance raise is largely attributed to the acquisition, not organic momentum, and the core outlook is flat, resulting in a mildly positive score.

summary.revenue: Q2 2025 sales of $24.0 billion, comparable sales up 1.1%.
summary.eps: GAAP diluted EPS of $4.27; adjusted diluted EPS of $4.33, an increase of 5.6% over prior year.
summary.guidance: Full year 2025 outlook updated to reflect ADG: sales $84.5-$85.5 billion, comparable sales flat to +1%, adjusted operating margin 12.2%-12.3%, adjusted diluted EPS $12.20-$12.45. Core business expectations unchanged. Q3 comp sales expected ~125 bps above bottom end of full year guide. FBM acquisition not included in outlook.
summary.margin: Adjusted gross margin 33.8%, up 37 bps from last year. Adjusted operating margin 14.7%, up 23 bps versus prior year. Full year adjusted operating margin expected 12.2%-12.3%.
key_risks: Elevated mortgage rates and cautious consumer behavior
Affordability pressure and lock-in effect from low housing turnover
Labor cost increases for Pro customers
Shortage of skilled trades in some regions
Integration risk from ADG and FBM acquisitions
key_opportunities: Acquisition of FBM to expand Large Pro offering and access $250 billion TAM
Cross-selling opportunities between FBM, ADG, and Lowe's
Aging housing stock and $50 billion deferred project demand
Continued Pro and online growth momentum
Perpetual Productivity Improvement (PPI) initiatives driving margin
My Lowe's Rewards and creator network for customer engagement
Daltile brand addition and expanded Pro brand lineup
